snippet.title: HYPERVIOLENT - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
HYPERVIOLENT launches into full version on September 23, 2025 as part of the Boomstock 2025 event!

The old-school sci-fi horror FPS oozing with atmosphere is now available in Early Access on PC, via Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store and other digital stores. Play it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409200/HYPERVIOLENT/
https://www.gog.com/en/game/hyperviolent
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/hyperviolent-5d1983

An ancient evil awoke in the depths a remote asteroid, stirred from its slumber by a man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become trapped, surrounded by hordes of monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this gloriously violent retro shooter!

Follow us:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/FulqrumPublishing
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/FulqrumPublishing
Website: http://www.FulqrumPublishing.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FulqrumPublishing/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/FulqrumPub
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/FulqrumPublishing/

#Retro #FPS #horrorgaming
